sprite.about: One creature or prop still, in the anchor's ink, camera and scale. The subject names the creature and its palette.
sprite.pre: The reference image is a style and camera reference only. Match its ink line weight, woodcut hatching, cream parchment fill, three-quarter top-down camera angle, and sprite scale exactly, but draw a completely different subject; do not copy the reference creature. Subject:
sprite.post: Style: a medieval manuscript marginalia drollery drawn as a bold woodcut print. Thick, confident black ink outlines, simplified chunky shapes, a little bold black hatching for shadow only, no fine cross-hatching. Camera: a single isolated game sprite seen in three-quarter top-down view, camera above and in front looking down at 45 degrees. Whole body fully visible with empty margin on all sides, centered, facing right, in profile-three-quarter. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame, transparent background.

fx.about: An effect texture: black ink on a flat white fill, so the game can tint it.
fx.pre: The reference image is a style reference only. Match its bold black woodcut ink line weight, chunky brush texture and sparse bold hatching exactly, but draw a completely different subject: a flat game visual-effect graphic. Do not draw the reference creature, no creature, no character, no face, no eyes. Subject:
fx.post: Style: a medieval manuscript marginalia ornament drawn as a bold woodcut print. Thick, confident black ink outlines and calligraphic brush strokes, simplified chunky shapes, a little bold black hatching for shading only, no fine cross-hatching, no gradients, no airbrush, no glow. Palette strictly black ink plus one flat solid pure white fill. The white fill covers most of the shape, including its arms, tongues and droplets; black ink is used only for the outlines and a few bold hatch strokes. No other colors, no grey, no cream, no yellow, no parchment tone. Camera: a single isolated game effect sprite, flat graphic seen straight on, centered, fully visible with empty margin on all sides. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame, transparent background.

concept.about: A wide scene in the reference's style, for mood and store art.
concept.pre: Same style as the reference: a medieval woodcut marginalia drawing on cream parchment.
